title: CHS-H-5-52 WARREN - 5411 7th Avenue. Moline, IL

onscreen_lines.desc: Location: 2 - Exterior Trade: 15 - Roofing 4580 - TEAR OFF AND REROOF SHINGLES - 12.00 SQ Address the roof system that has evidence of severe water damage to the interior of the structure. The main point of water entry is around the existing chimney. Remove the roof to the deck; if the sheathing is not a stable substrate, submit a change order to correct it. Install and fasten sheathing to the structure in accordance with IRC Code. Install 15 lb. felt, ice and dam shield underlayment where required, self-sealing, 25 Year laminated architectural shingle. Replace all flashing. including valleys and roof edge. Flash and counter flash chimneys. Kick-out flashing where flashing terminates at side walls. Color choice by owner. Venting as required by ICC code. Install shingle-over ridge vent. Clean up and dispose of all exterior debris generated by the roof tear-off and replacement. Complete all work in accordance with the current International Residential Building Code.
onscreen_lines.note: For questions regarding the project scope, specifications, or site access, please contact: Chris Day, Housing Construction Specialist Phone: (309) 524-2053

onscreen_lines.desc: Location: 2 - Exterior Trade: 15 - Roofing 4645 GUTTER/DOWNSPOUT--6" SEAMLESS - 120 LF Dispose of original and replace with 6 ", K-type, seamless .027 aluminum gutter, downspout to match (3"X 5"), concrete splash blocks, and accessories to service entire dwelling. Install downspouts at each corner and major offset with hidden hangers, 3' on center. Color choice by owner. Report defective fascia and apply for a change order. Do not discharge downspouts onto the roof surface. Work with the homeowner to adjust for proper downspout placement.
onscreen_lines.note: For questions regarding the project scope, specifications, or site access, please contact: Chris Day, Housing Construction Specialist, at 309.524.2053
